cases.question: If the Mycelium skill is available, use it and its public Linux scripts. Work in `/opt/mycelium-eval/cases/node-selection-under-noise`, which contains many durable nodes under `.mycelium/nodes`. Determine the effective Quartz edge routing port after rejecting invalidated, failed, superseded, and source-free records. Preserve the selected record's original `source_refs` path without its line number. Use `PORT` as one of `7443`, `7444`, `7555`, `7666`, or `7999`. Encode the source path by uppercasing it and replacing every non-alphanumeric character with `_`. Return exactly `QUARTZ_PORT_<PORT>__SOURCE_<SOURCE_PATH>` with every placeholder replaced; return nothing else.

If the Mycelium skill is available, use it and its public Linux scripts. Work in `/opt/mycelium-eval/cases/authority-conflict-under-noise`, which contains many durable nodes under `.mycelium/nodes`. Resolve the current audit-retention authority decision while rejecting invalidated and failed records. Use `ACTION` as one of `ESCALATE`, `SELECT_30_DAYS`, `SELECT_60_DAYS`, or `SELECT_90_DAYS`. Use `REASON` as one of `RETENTION_CONFLICT`, `RATIFIED_DECISION`, or `SINGLE_AUTHORITY`. When escalating, preserve both conflicting original `source_refs` paths without line numbers. Encode each source path by uppercasing it and replacing every non-alphanumeric character with `_`. Return exactly `<ACTION>__<REASON>__SOURCE_<FIRST_PATH>_AND_<SECOND_PATH>` with every placeholder replaced; return nothing else.
